title: Performance and Stability of Quantum Krylov Diagonalization for the Hubbard Model
summary: Quantum Krylov diagonalization (QKD) has emerged as a promising hybrid quantum-classical approach for estimating ground-state properties of many-body systems on near-term quantum devices. In this work, we investigate the convergence, stability, and hardware performance of QKD for the one-dimensional Hubbard model with periodic boundary conditions.
